{{< video videos/eevee_focus.mp4 >}}

Calmodulin (1CLL) with helix 5 to 19 in gold. The rest of the chain is a second cartoon
     style with a `Transparent` material, and its transparency socket is tweened to fade the
     context. Focus is Blender's own depth of field, pulled from the helix to residues 82 to 92
     and back with `canvas.camera.focus`.

     Depth of field at Molecular Nodes' world scale is gentler than ProteinMotion's at the
     same f-number, so the apertures here are wider than in the original.

After ProteinMotion's [`eevee_focus.py`](https://github.com/pdpppd/proteinmotion/blob/main/examples/eevee_focus.py).

## Script

Run it with `uv run python docs/examples/timeline/scripts/eevee_focus.py out_dir`; set
`MN_EXAMPLES_QUICK=1` for a small, fast check. The script is included from the file:

```{.python filename="scripts/eevee_focus.py"}
{{< include scripts/eevee_focus.py >}}
```
